subject.title: Preserve aborted sessions across restart opt-in

question: Should OpenClaw accept `session.restartContinuation` as a new opt-in session config contract after the branch is repaired against current main?
rationale: The branch adds operator-facing configuration and changes session-id reuse semantics; that product contract cannot be settled by code review alone.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this PR for now and keep the linked issue open for a maintainer-selected restart recovery design.

options.title: Repair Then Sponsor Opt-In
options.body: Keep the PR open only if a maintainer wants this exact config-gated restart-continuation contract after the merge-result and proof issues are fixed.

options.title: Require Config-Free Recovery
options.body: Redirect the work toward a restart recovery mechanism that avoids adding another session config knob.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR for now and keep the linked issue open for a maintainer-selected restart recovery design.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best current routing candidate from the available history and PR timeline for this session/Gateway decision.
